```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a pairplot
pairplot = sns.pairplot(df, hue='species', diag_kind='kde', markers=["o", "s", "D"])

# Add a title to the pairplot
pairplot.fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset Pairplot', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
